第一卷 第13章 俯首认错人心冷暖（第1页）
赵山站在门口，手中提着一个布囊，神色忐忑不安。
他昨日得知苏玄尘是极品天灵根天才之后，一夜未眠。
他万万没想到，自己连日嘲讽、主动寻衅的百岁老朽。
竟是整个青玄宗、整个青州都极其罕见的绝世仙苗。
他在外门的修行之路，直接断绝，甚至会被严惩逐出门墙。
一夜思虑，他终于下定决心，上门负荆请罪。
“师弟前日眼拙，不识天骄，多次冒犯师兄，言语无状，多有得罪。”
“今日特地前来，向苏师兄赔罪，还望师兄海涵。”
“这里是师弟积攒的三十块下品灵石、三枚下品疗伤丹，一点薄礼，聊表歉意，还请师兄收下。”
跟前几日嚣张跋扈、仗势欺人的模样，判若两人。
苏玄尘静静看着他，神色平淡无波。
百年岁月，他看惯了人情冷暖、世态炎凉。
世人敬的从来不是人，是实力、是天赋、是未来。
前日他看似弱小可欺，人人都能上来踩一脚。
今日他天赋曝光，万众瞩目，昔日仇敌主动低头认错、送礼赔罪。
修仙界，和凡俗红尘，终究是一个道理。
“修行之人，戒骄戒躁。你年少气盛，争强好胜，不算大错。”
“东西你收回，过往之事，我既往不咎。”
赵山闻言，猛地抬头，满脸难以置信。
他本以为最少也要被冷脸斥责、刁难一番。
没想到苏玄尘如此大度，直接一笔勾销！
巨大的惊喜，瞬间冲散他所有惶恐。
心性气度，远非他们这些寻常少年弟子可比！
“多谢师兄宽宏大量！多谢师兄！”
赵山连连躬身道谢，心中彻底放下大石。
“外门不少核心弟子、天才种子，都盯着这次秘境试炼。”
“他们心里，多半不服您一位百岁老者压过所有人。”
“试炼之内，鱼龙混杂，无人监管。”
“师弟担心……有人暗中对师兄下手，您务必多加小心！”
说完，赵山不敢多留，躬身行礼，转身快步离去。
苏玄尘立于院中，微风拂动灰白长发。
他以百岁之龄，压过所有少年天才，独占宗门重视。
但秘境之内，杀机暗藏，最适合暗中下手、抹去痕迹。
他年已百岁，历经沧桑，早已不是心慈手软的少年。
青玄宗外门所有炼气一层以上弟子，尽数集结山门之外。
所有人目光炽热，望向远方云雾缭绕的青峦秘境山脉。
一场属于外门的厮杀、夺宝、争锋。
而人群末尾，白发佝偻的苏玄尘，静静伫立。
将在此次秘境之中，彻底绽放光芒，震惊全场！

Volume 1, Chapter 13: Bowing down and admitting one’s mistake, one’s heart is cold and warm (Page 1)
Zhao Shan stood at the door, holding a cloth bag in his hand and looking uneasy.
He stayed up all night after learning that Su Xuanchen was a top-grade Tianlinggen genius yesterday.
He never expected that he would be a hundred-year-old man who he had been mocking and actively provoking for days.
It was actually a peerless immortal seedling that was extremely rare in the entire Qingxuan Sect and the entire Qingzhou.
His path of cultivation in the outer sect will be cut off directly, and he may even be severely punished and expelled from the outer gate.
After thinking about it all night, he finally made up his mind and came to plead guilty.
"Junior brother was blind the other day and didn't recognize the genius. He offended senior brother many times. His words were incomprehensible and offended many times."
"I came here specifically today to apologize to Senior Brother Su and to wish Senior Brother Haihan."
"Here are thirty low-grade spiritual stones, three low-grade healing pills, and a few small gifts that junior brother has accumulated. I would like to express my apology and ask senior brother to accept them."
He was completely different from the arrogant, domineering and bullying person he had been in the past few days.
Su Xuanchen looked at him quietly, with a calm expression.
Over the course of hundreds of years, he has become accustomed to seeing the warmth and warmth of people and the harshness of the world.
What the world respects is never people, but strength, talent, and the future.
The day before yesterday, he seemed weak and easy to bully, and anyone could step on him.
Today, his talent was exposed and attracted everyone's attention. His former enemies took the initiative to bow their heads and admit their mistakes, and sent gifts to apologize.
The world of cultivating immortals and the mortal world are ultimately the same.
"Practitioners, beware of arrogance and impetuosity. You are young and energetic, and you are competitive and competitive. It is not a big mistake."
"You take back the things, and I will let the past be bygones."
Upon hearing this, Zhao Shan suddenly raised his head, his face full of disbelief.
He expected to at least be scolded and made things difficult for him with a cold face.
I didn't expect Su Xuanchen to be so generous and write it off immediately!
The huge surprise instantly dispelled all his fears.
His character and demeanor are far beyond those of ordinary young disciples like them!
"Thank you, senior brother, for your generosity! Thank you, senior brother!"
Zhao Shan bowed and thanked him repeatedly, feeling completely relieved.
"Many core disciples and genius seeds from the outer sect are staring at this secret realm trial."
"In their hearts, most of them are dissatisfied with the fact that you, a hundred-year-old man, can dominate everyone else."
"Within the trial, there is a mixture of fish and dragons, and there is no one to supervise it."
"Junior brother is worried...someone is secretly attacking senior brother, you must be more careful!"
After saying that, Zhao Shan did not dare to stay any longer, bowed and saluted, turned around and left quickly.
Su Xuanchen stood in the courtyard, his long gray hair ruffling in the breeze.
At the age of 100, he surpassed all the young geniuses and monopolized the sect's attention.
But within the secret realm, murderous intentions are hidden, making it the perfect place to start secretly and erase traces.
He is a hundred years old and has gone through many vicissitudes of life. He is no longer a soft-hearted young man.
All the disciples above the first level of Qi Refining in the outer sect of Qingxuan Sect gathered outside the mountain gate.
Everyone looked at the mist-shrouded Qingluan Secret Mountains in the distance with blazing eyes.
A fight, treasure hunt, and competition belonging to the outer sect.
At the end of the crowd, the white-haired Su Xuanchen stood quietly.
In this secret realm, the light will completely shine and shock the whole audience!
